proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5679 explicitly identifies the ll-extension in Bengali tātal, Oriya tātalā/tātilā and Bhojpuri/Hindi tātal hot. The Bhil tātlo/tātlũ/tataḷo variants fit that extension rather than unextended tapta; local shortening and lateral realization are retained. Exact source form tataḷo is preserved.
